rows.answer: At 2024-06-28 the rule sees a neutral regime (Panic Index 29.02, percentile 28.7; VIX 12.44, Fear & Greed 44.31), so it does nothing and holds 0% — well below its 50% starting point. Two triggers would change that: an add if the index closes above 64 (a panic reading), and a reduction of 10% if it closes below 15 (greed). Because the rule sits at the floor, only panic days can move it up, one 20% add per such day, capped at 100%; there is no further room to reduce. Fed context is only background: the Committee's stated intention to keep policy restrictive until confident inflation is heading to 2 percent (minutes-20230920) and Chair Powell's framing of proceeding carefully (press_conference-20231101) offer no regime signal here. Historical research, not investment advice.
